First release of NUONDroid, a NUON emulator for Android built on NuanceResurrection.

- Runs NUON games from .iso, .chd and .zip disc images, or an extracted disc's NUON/nuon.run
- Library with Continue playing, Settings and an in-game menu (Select + Start), in the same style as JagDroid
- Scanlines (Light / Strong), 4:3, stretch or sharp-pixel 4:3 screen, optional CRT shader
- Right stick works as the NUON C-pad
- Updates itself from GitHub releases: Settings > Updates > Check for updates

Experimental. There's no ARM JIT for the core yet, so games run on the interpreter and some will be below full speed.
